Suppression anchor regression fixture for the existing actual benchmark worker.

The production change adds distinct candidate-file and marker-file anchors before the two broad token/SourceLocation joins. Candidate rows are not used directly as token seeds. File suppression checks retain the original three-column range projection; range suppression retains its original eight-column token projection. Every marker predicate, other producer, parameter and output remains unchanged. Nested ignore comment/head captures move earlier using comment-only dependencies. The quoted/continued-token mapping branch is unchanged.

`baseline.ryoql` freezes the prior helper (SHA256 `5ea3e0a1f045bf62b81e17c8c536a5ed47ba02859ff9544d769618c5fc762bde`). The measured candidate helper is `72eaeed41d5a9a6393d5048cb7bf7389479a9ce622f4748db92f980e724a8b80`.

Run `verify.py --worker <actual-worker> --baseline-module baseline.ryoql --candidate-module <production-suppress.ryoql> --output <fresh-artifact-directory>` from any directory. It stages both modules independently and uses a newly empty cache for every invocation; it never deletes another cache. It does not invoke Ruff or Cargo.

Eight focused cases include duplicate candidate rows/markers, no marker, no candidate, nested ignore without the ordinary range prefix, another rule's marker, multiple files, parser recovery and incomplete lexical input. Six complete worker report pairs match exactly. The worker refuses both incomplete cases, so their exact exit status and full Unknown/refusal messages are compared instead of fabricating a partial report. Two direct probes check that neither anchor multiplies token identities.

The actual compiled operations recorded by worker2ea keep the same candidate-file GroupCount seed on the left of both marker intersections and then both token joins, before SourceLocation enrichment. Assertions check both deduplicated marker groups and original output schemas. No-marker/no-candidate probes verify zero builds/probes/hits at the targeted enrichment stages; the code branch is not executed and the range branch records an empty invocation. A complete source-DAG guard pins all other bindings and every SourceLocation producer. Step tracing does not enumerate optimizer-retained steps that are never executed; this limitation is explicit in `proof.json`.

`proof.json` records the exact worker/module/caller/fixture/request hashes and reports from `/tmp/suppression-anchors-focused-20261101`. These are correctness/structure checks, not timing measurements. Integration separately measured the same helper bytes against the frozen 310-rule `options.py` request: all six reports matched, payload decodes fell by 45.8%, and wall-time samples were mixed. No whole-corpus or subsecond performance result is claimed.
